newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES WEEK MIXED ON KEY UNITS.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR CLOSES WEEK MIXED ON KEY UNITS.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar closed a busy Friday interbank market session slightly firmer on the U.S. dollar but weaker on sterling and the mark, foreign exchange dealers said.

"We saw a lot of foreign exchange coming into the market today, some foreign banks came in to buy Zimdollars and the local dollar at one time was trading at 10.7300/7500 on the U.S. dollar before the Reserve Bank came in to mop up the excess," one dealer said.
After the central bank intervention, he said, the dollar closed at 10.7350/7550 compared to 10.7400/7600 late Thursday.
It weakened to 17.8000/8500 on sterling from 17.7200/7700 and to 6.9600/9800 on the mark versus 6.9500/9700.
The Zimbabwe dollar also softened on the rand to 2.2650/2750 compared to 2.2600/2800 after the South African unit recovered somewhat on Friday from its eight-cent fall on the U.S. dollar on Thursday.
